correctness.rationale: Finite-state harmonic system constructed for all six graph types. Exact rational-function solution verifies all state equations; full difference-sign factorization and shifted-factor positivity prove all continuum signs. The unique root is ensured by Descartes single sign change and rational endpoint bracket; six edge types are exhaustive by canonical graph enumeration, and the n=3 difference proves sharp minimality. Exact-arithmetic standalone script was executed and passed. This is not a finite experimental extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The 2009 small-graph paper already demonstrates a qualitative fitness-dependent path–paw ordering reversal, so that observation is explicitly excluded as a novelty claim. The exact positive root of the ninth-degree integer polynomial, its uniqueness on the entire continuum r>1, every other strict edge-addition sign, and four-vertex sharp classification were not found as prior results in the inspected primary full texts and targeted mathematical-record searches. The 2008 special-graph source was available only through abstract/bibliography, and an unlocated exact identity remains a priority risk.
residual_risks: The 2009 paper establishes the qualitative reversal already, so novelty is strictly limited to the exact threshold, uniqueness, six-edge all-fitness classifications and minimality.
The 2008 special-classes paper was not fully readable and may provide rational functions from which part of the theorem is implicit.
An unlocated historical full table or stronger all-graph theorem might imply some exact signs.

value.rationale: The smallest complete structural classification of edge-addition effects under fixed birth-death replacement budgets is a natural evolutionary-graph question. The critical fitness, rigorous one-crossing property and sharp minimum make the prior numerical ranking reversal a usable exact phase diagram. This does not pretend to be a general theorem for larger evolutionary networks.
